name: Diffusion Tensor Visualization using Random Field Correlation
aliases: Adaptive filtering of noise fields for DTI
definition: A volume rendering method that visualizes diffusion tensor fields by correlating a random noise field anisotropically using the diffusion tensor, preserving high-frequency components in transversal directions while smearing noise in the direction of greater diffusivity.
summary: Diffusion Tensor Visualization using Random Field Correlation renders scalar volumes from anisotropic noise correlation, avoiding geometric primitives to solve occlusion and starting-point dependency.
